bannedDependencies.message:
cyclonedx-core-java 13.0.0+ detected!
Note for the future Sonatype engineer who trips this enforcer rule: When adding the MCP tools to IQ there was a transitive dependency `mcp-json-jackson2` -> `json-schema-validator:2.x`. However `cyclonedx-core-java` 12.x in extensive use requires `json-schema-validator:1.x`. To resolve this we created a `noOpJsonSchemaValidator` in McpServletProvider and excluded json-schema-validator from mcp-json-jackson2 in insight-brain-guide/pom.xml. Once cyclonedx-core-java 13.0.0+ lands on the classpath (via insight-scanner) that means `json-schema-validator` 2.x is now supported across all dependencies and the workaround can be removed.
`cyclonedx-core-java` v13.+ supports json-schema-validator 2.x, so the MCP json-schema-validator workaround can be removed: 1. Remove the json-schema-validator exclusion from mcp-json-jackson2 in insight-brain-guide/pom.xml 2. Remove the noOpJsonSchemaValidator() method in McpServletProvider 3. Remove the .jsonSchemaValidator(...) call in McpServletProvider.initialize() 4. Remove this enforcer rule See: https://github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-core-java/pull/802
